result.title: InducedTFMs: A Family of Sub-Quadratic Tabular Foundation Models Using Induced Attention
result.summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have emerged as a serious competitor to gradient-boosted trees, predicting on a new table in a single forward pass by in-context learning. However, their attention is quadratic in the number of samples and features, which caps pretraining at small synthetic tables and forces inference on large ones to rely on chunking or subsampling. Row-compression models reduce the feature-wise cost, but only by discarding the cell-level representation, and remain quadratic in the number of samples. We introduce InducedTFM, which replaces both attention stages of a bidimensional TFM with the induced attention of the Set Transformer, preserving cell-level representations while making its cost linear in both samples and features. Under a training budget matched to a full-attention TabICLv2 reimplementation, InducedTFM matches its accuracy on TabArena and on a benchmark of larger datasets, and clearly outperforms a kernel linear-attention baseline of the same asymptotic cost. It overtakes TabICLv2 in inference time on narrow tables, reaching a 30x speed-up at 640K rows, although row compression remains preferable on wide tables.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 InducedTFM，用 Set Transformer 的 induced attention 替换表格基础模型的两级注意力，在保留 cell 级表示的同时把样本与特征维度上的开销降为线性，并在 TabArena 等基准上与全注意力模型精度相当、推理更快。
AI.relevance_reason: 其诱导点压缩上下文、以线性代价维持细粒度表示的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态与视觉证据的压缩、以及长上下文的计算成本提供可供核查的架构线索，但论文本身不涉及多模态推理。
